Meet Suzana

Purpose, polish and a deep sense of home.

Suzana Sampeur is a Haitian-born real estate professional, entrepreneur and media host. After representing Haiti on the international stage as Miss World Haiti 2016, she built a career centered on service, communication and community.

Today, she helps clients navigate residential real estate in South Florida and represents opportunities at Village Nounouche in Cap-Haïtien—connecting the Haitian diaspora with thoughtful paths to ownership and investment.

“Home is more than an address. It is where your plans, your people and your future come together.”
